head: 07481358c2d7ccba6c2a85f1c11e288d3a825a1b
summary:
All five acceptance items hold, checked against the tree with my own commands. Contact is code only. The real act this slice routes, a person running `--filter Network=SMB-LOOPBACK`, is person-run by contract, and I did not run it.

What holds:
- SL-038's O-030 in .taad/slices/SL-038/build-slice-2.json:108 now reads `"done": false`. Its how-text is unchanged byte for byte.
- `git diff --numstat 6c57f0c HEAD` shows 1 line in / 1 out on that ledger and 11 in / 2 out on docs/design/SL-020-scanner.md. The rest of the diff is the two tests/bugs scripts and SL-062's own engine records. No file under src, eng, tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests, tests/window or tests/CfProvider changed.
- `SL-062-LedgerCases.ps1 -Case All` exits 0, with every check in C-002..C-005 holding.
- I wrote my own scan of SL-038's JSON for O-030 in all three record shapes the engine uses (done, discharged, verified), plus key/id/obligation fields and state/status. It finds exactly two copies: build-slice-2.json (done False) and code-review-2.json (discharged 'no'). index.json:429 lists the key only in a caused_by list, with no state.
- The person's record, SL-020-scanner.md, now has an O-030 entry. It gives the command whole and the ~70 s run time, says the result goes next to N-001..N-004, and says spike#55's agent run does not discharge O-030.
- The default Core.Tests suite passes 374/374. It runs 0 StalledShareTests results, because the default filter excludes that trait. RigLockScopeWordingTests reads the edited .md and passed.
- Fitness: all 59 rules hold.
- A read-only Get-SmbMapping shows 0 leftover \\127.0.0.1 mappings.
- The acceptance repro's exit 0 is the engine's measurement. I did not re-run it.

Still open: O-016, owed to build-slice. tests/bugs/SL-062-LedgerCases.ps1:154 still matches only `done` or `discharged`, not `verified`. So C-004's stated guarantee is still wider than what it checks. It has no effect today, since no verified-shaped O-030 exists under SL-038 (I checked all shapes independently). It is still work the slice owes, and nothing in the tree has done it.

Observed, not graded: SL-038's build-slice-2.json still says in its not_built prose 'Nothing in the obligations was left undone'. Criterion 3 requires the rest of that file to stay byte-identical, so leaving it is correct. Its follow_ups line already routes StalledShareTests to a person.

The bug report was a title only. I took the slice brief, which is SL-038 code-review-2.json finding m1 and its fix text, as the report, and 'the ledger' to mean SL-038's obligation record plus the person-run network check in SL-020-scanner.md.

There is no loop: one build attempt, one code review, and no send-backs.

criteria.how: Engine measurement (O-001): exit 0 now, exit 1 at reproduction. I did not re-run it, per the stage rules. C-005 shows the test's content is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: 1. Flip O-030's ledger discharge state when its own how-text admits the test never ran and is owed to the person
criteria.how: The diff shows build-slice-2.json:108 changed from "done": true to "done": false under key O-030. My independent parse reads done=False.

criteria.criterion: 2. The how-text survives byte-identical, still containing 'NEVER run' and 'remains owed to the person'
criteria.how: C-002 compares O-030.how at 6c57f0c against the tree ordinally: equal, both phrases present, shape {key,done,how}. The diff hunk shows the how line only as context.

criteria.criterion: 3. The rest of build-slice-2.json is byte-identical; git diff shows exactly one changed line
criteria.how: `git diff --numstat 6c57f0c HEAD` gives 1 1 for the ledger. C-003 finds the same line count and exactly one differing line, with no BOM. `git ls-files --eol` shows i/lf, so the committed blob change is one line.

criteria.criterion: 4. Confirm the fix reaches the person's sitting when a second copy of O-030's state exists elsewhere under .taad
criteria.how: My own scan of SL-038 covers all three engine record shapes (done/discharged/verified) plus state/status. It finds only two copies, both undischarged: done False and discharged 'no'. index.json holds a bare key with no state. The person-run network check in SL-020-scanner.md carries the O-030 entry with the command, the ~70 s run time, placement next to N-001..N-004, and the statement that the agent run does not discharge it. Two limits: the engine's own store is outside the tree (see not_reached), and C-004's detector still misses verified-shaped copies (O-016).

criteria.criterion: 5. StalledShareTests.cs, Rig/SmbRig.cs and the repro test are unmodified
criteria.how: `git diff --name-only` over src, eng, tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests, tests/window and tests/CfProvider is empty, both against the base and in the worktree. C-005 reports both files untouched and the repro's hash unchanged. The default suite passes 374/374.
